v2_required_sequence.purpose: Hold the existing competitive11 macrostate fixed, perturb police professionalism and government/insurgent formation experience as hidden states, and test whether future outcome distributions materially change under common random numbers.
Compare competitive11v2 against an augmented macrostate containing police professionalism and both government and insurgent veterancy using adversarial matched full-state continuations.
Activate both insurgent reproduction and hierarchical state regeneration to test whether state flows alter survival, rebound, and control without assuming a scalar state reproduction number.
Derive and freeze the smallest surviving reduced system, then test untouched seeds, parameter cells, interventions, scales, and topology families.
Test agent resolution, topology family, scheduling resolution, and structural-context invariance of the surviving v2 laws.
Eligible historical transport and reduced competitors only after a corrected v2 synthetic freeze.
